subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs be merged under the current fail-closed SecretRef semantics, or should this wait for optional TTS SecretRef degradation?
rationale: The central bug fix is in the right shared layer, but collecting a previously ignored TTS SecretRef path can make missing persona provider credentials fail earlier and more strictly than existing users see today.

options.title: Require proof and boundary review
options.body: Merge only after redacted live persona SecretRef TTS/Gateway proof and maintainer confirmation that the current fail-closed behavior is acceptable or separately mitigated.

options.title: Accept strict behavior now
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge the collector fix now and accept that unresolved persona TTS refs follow the existing strict SecretRef failure path.

options.title: Pause for optional degradation
options.body: Pause this PR until the related optional TTS SecretRef degradation path lands if maintainers do not want persona TTS keys to add a new startup-fatal surface.

recommendation.title: Require proof and boundary review
recommendation.body: Merge only after redacted live persona SecretRef TTS/Gateway proof and maintainer confirmation that the current fail-closed behavior is acceptable or separately mitigated.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the SecretRef runtime framework and active target semantics introduced in the broad SecretRef coverage work.
